rule.statement: A litigant who attempts to pollute the stream of justice or who touches the pure fountain of justice with tainted hands is not entitled to any relief.
rule.supporting_quote: The above observation is not only of relevance to India, as it may apply with equal force to other nations, neighbouring as well as more distant, where there is a great need for the courts to be more vigilant in their quest to ascertain the truth, and to deal more strictly than they may have done in the past, with litigants whose deception or fraudulent conduct is detected.
